recoveryEncoding: Every recovered route/id pair is in rootRows; decode.mjs expands roots, counts and recoveryIds without omission.
dimensionsPolicy: Widths use the confirmed 1440px desktop source. Exact height is checked only when supplied as current source evidence; historical native heights are informational.
rasterPolicy: Return every observed IMAGE ID and flag full UI raster candidates for owner review. Geometry alone does not establish image contents; this read changes nothing.
backgroundPolicy: Observe root color, opacity and binding parity against current Aurora Dark tokens; no corrections are performed.
whiteLayoutPolicy: Include native SLOT plus FRAME/RECTANGLE/COMPONENT/INSTANCE; visible opaque resolved white layout fills at width>=64 and height>=8. Preserve explicit Light contexts. TEXT/VECTOR/BOOLEAN_OPERATION/ELLIPSE/POLYGON/STAR/LINE paints remain excluded; lowering height does not widen the checked node types to artwork or text foreground.
